bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
target='theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV'
base=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 21
test -d "$base" || exit 22
matches=0
active=0
while IFS= read -r unit; do
 [ -n "$unit" ] || continue
 body="$(systemctl --user cat "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)"
 if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Fqi "$target"; then
   matches=$((matches+1))
   if systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit"; then active=$((active+1)); fi
 fi
done < <(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'TARGET_MATCHES=%s ACTIVE=%s\n' "$matches" "$active"
[ "$matches" -eq 1 ] || exit 42
[ "$active" -eq 1 ] || exit 41
n="$(find "$base" -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -iname '*.mp4' -o -iname '*.mkv' -o -iname '*.mov' -o -iname '*.webm' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
printf 'ROOT_VIDEO_FILES=%s\n' "$n"
if [ "$n" -ge 150 ]; then exit 250; fi
exit $((100+n))
